FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF BIOPHYSICS
BMS BLOCK–II, SOUTH CAMPUS, SECTOR-25, PANJAB UNIVERSITY
CHANDIGARH-160014
Advertisement for the post of Project Technical Support-III
Applications are invited for One (01) position of Project Technical Support-III in the Indian
Council of Medical Research (ICMR) sponsored research project entitled “Development of
Hepcidin-Targeted Therapies for Anemia” sanctioned to the undersigned.
No. of Positions: One (01)
Essential Qualifications: Candidate must possess a three years B.Sc/graduate degree with three
years experience OR M.Sc./PG degree with a minimum of 55% marks in
Biophysics/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Allied fields.
“Candidates with UGC-NET/GATE/ other national entrance test conducted by Government of
India will be preferred.”
Desirable Experience: Prior knowledge of molecular modeling, software, biomolecular
simulations, various biochemical and spectrophotometric assays, cell culture, and molecular
biology techniques.
Emoluments/Fellowship: The selected candidate will be paid stipend of Rs. 28000/- pm
+20%HRA.
Age Limit: 35 years
Other relaxations as per ICMR and Panjab University norms are applicable
How to apply:
Candidates fulfilling the above criteria may submit their application (on plain paper) to the
undersigned along with a detailed resume (with email, address & contact no.), attested copies of
certificates, and work experience or publications by 18th February 2026. The date and venue of
the interview shall be conveyed via email or Phone to the eligible candidates. No separate call letter
will be issued for the interview.
Note: No TA/DA will be provided. The post is purely temporary and commensurate with the
project.
Dr. Naveen Kaushal
Principal Investigator
Department of Biophysics
Panjab University, Chandigarh- 160014
Email: nkaushal@pu.ac.in
